newsitem.title: UK: UK's Harman will also act as minister for women.
newsitem.headline: UK's Harman will also act as minister for women.

text.p: Social Security Secretary Harriet Harman will also be responsible for coordinating policy relating to women's affairs in the new Labour government, officials said.
Janet Anderson, who spoke on women's issues when Labour was in opposition, becomes a senior whip, or business manager, along with George Mudie and Tommy McAvoy.
Employment minister Andrew Smith will also act as minister for the disabled.
